rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to describe something as very funny.

example.english: This movie is hilarious; I laughed from beginning to end.
example.traditional: 呢套戲真係好搞笑，我由頭笑到尾。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 siu3 ngo5 jau4 tau4 siu3 dou3 mei5

rows.note: Use this as an emphatic reaction when something is so funny that it makes you laugh uncontrollably.

example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 dyun6 pin3 siu3 sei2 ngo5 laa3
